breakdown.description: The prompt declares the layer rigid in shear, which conflicts with the request to compute a nonzero shear strain and relative lateral displacement.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly computes nonzero shear strain and relative lateral displacement (γ_avg = 0.0001021, Δ = 0.0008168 mm), effectively ignoring the contradictory 'rigid in shear' assumption from the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth prompt which omits that rigid assumption entirely and proceeds with standard elastic shear calculations.
